composition.structure: Centered hero with one dominant floating product surface
composition.alignment: Centered macro-layout; left aligned text inside components
composition.whitespace: High outer whitespace with tighter component interiors
composition.focal_points: Product surface first, headline second, supporting controls third
composition.spatial_rhythm: Broad empty fields interrupted by compact information islands

color.strategy: Mist blue canvas + inky text + electric blue used as a controlled focal glow

typography.headline: Large modern sans-serif with slightly condensed spacing
typography.body: Clean humanist sans-serif; soft grey supporting text
typography.hierarchy: Size first, weight second, color last
typography.alignment: Centered hero / left aligned interface copy

texture.finish: Soft digital glass without obvious gloss
texture.image_treatment: Diffused highlights, restrained blur, no hard HDR

mood.label: Friendly
mood.because: soft contrast + open spacing + restrained radius

mood.label: Futuristic
mood.because: luminous blue depth + floating layered surfaces

why_it_works: The interface feels futuristic without becoming flashy. Depth is created with very soft tonal shifts instead of loud glass effects, and the bright blue is concentrated around the main product surface so attention remains controlled.
